Thad speaks the options as the voice of the dead; FRAME is `seance_frame`, his voice at the table (the tent's `voices`), not the Clarion's figure. opening.speaker: ozymandia
opening.line: We call upon the spirit of Obadiah Mott.

opening.speaker: ozymandia
opening.line: Obadiah Mott. The town is waiting.

opening.speaker: ozymandia
opening.line: Obadiah Mott — two dollars a head —

opening.speaker: ozymandia
opening.line: The spirits say he is… busy.

opening.speaker: seance_frame
opening.line: BUSY? Twelve years dead and BUSY?

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: That is the wind, darling. The wind is free.

options.repeat: Still the wind. It is a very persistent wind.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: The dead take up hobbies, darling.

exchange.speaker: seance_frame
exchange.line: He said that already. Still good.

options.text: The gold is under the church.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Two chairs go over. Two pairs of boots leave at a run.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: The spirits are not responsible for directions.

options.text: I am Obadiah Mott, and I am dead.

exchange.speaker: seance_frame
exchange.line: 'I AM DEAD,' says Mott. Front page. Within the hour.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: She looks down at the cloth for a long moment.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: The lamp comes up. Thad stays where he is until the last pair of boots has gone.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: I have now been dead once. It is mostly waiting under furniture.
